mentions.sentence: Malicious attackers may use these vulnerabilities to steal user information, embezzle data, crash the system, and bring unpredictable economic losses[7, 8, 9, 10].
mentions.context_before: ever, like other large and complex systems, DBMSs inevitably contain many vulnerabilities that affect user experience and may even cause serious security issues. Among them, it is quite common that a vulnerability is caused by configuration. According to the information released by the National Informa tion Security Vulnerability Database (CNNVD), a large number of database management systems have vulnerabilities due to configuration. For example, the MongoDB database had a data breach in 2017 because authentication was not enabled by default. The same p roblem occurs with other databases[11].
mentions.context_after: Recently, coverage -guided greybox fuzzing has become a ho t topic and achieved great success in the field of database vulnerability finding. Unlike blackbox fuzzing, coverage -guided greybox fuzzing introduces code coverage as feedback into the fuzzing loop and makes the fuzzing campaign evolve in the direction of i mproving code coverage. analysis.summary: An empirical study of configuration-related branch statements in DBMS source code -- the branches whose outcome depends on a configuration option -- quantifying how much behaviour is reachable only under non-default settings.
analysis.narrative: The single mention is a citation in the opening motivation about the consequences of DBMS vulnerabilities, reachable only through the citation marker. SQLancer is not named and plays no role in the study, whose method is static analysis of branch conditions.

uses_infrastructure.reasoning: SQLancer is cited as related work; no reuse of its code, generator or workload is described.

extends_technique.reasoning: No SQLancer technique is extended; the citation is background.

compares_with.reasoning: No empirical comparison against SQLancer or one of its oracles is reported.

describes_as_state_of_the_art.reasoning: The text does not describe SQLancer as the state of the art.
